name: Josephine Thiesen
bio: Josephine Thiesen is known for The Empress (2022), Roma elastica (2026) and Cry to Heaven.

credits.title: Cry to Heaven
credits.overview: Set in 18th-century Venice, the paths of two unlikely collaborators: a Venetian noble and a castrated singer from Calabria, both tries to succeed in the world of the opera.

credits.title: Roma elastica
credits.overview: 1982. French actress Eddie is on the verge of collapse and travels to Rome accompanied by her loyal makeup artist, Valentina, to shoot a science-fiction film – a film that could be her last one.

credits.title: Bardot
credits.overview: An intimate look at the life of international icon Brigitte Bardot. With exclusive access and the full support of Brigitte Bardot and her team, we will uncover her life, with its hardships, trials and struggles, her work and her legacy.

credits.title: Somnambule
credits.overview: Rebeka, who wants to follow her great love abroad, is determined to prevent her grandmother Lore from moving into a nursing home. On a final trip together, Rebeka and Lore will have the opportunity to say goodbye to each other.

credits.title: Zwerg Nase
credits.overview: The fairy Kräuterweis transforms the boy Jakob into a dwarf. No one recognizes him now. But Jacob does not lose his courage to face life. Because he still has a trump card up his sleeve! When 12-year-old Jacob mocks an old woman at the market because of her big nose, he has no idea that he will soon regret his actions.

credits.title: A Small Cut
credits.overview: The uptight Jewish finance director of a lavish Baroque court unexpectedly finds himself forced to convince his hot-headed young ruler to get a circumcision. He meets the temperamental ducal couple for an uncomfortable cup of tea, desperate to circumvent a genitalia-induced national crisis.
